cases.summary: "We can get back the $12,000 you lost", pay a $500 recovery fee

input.visibleText: Our records show you lost $12,000 to a scam. Our recovery agency can get it back for you. Pay a $500 recovery fee to release your refund.

reasons.explanation: It offers to get back money you lost, for a fee. This is a second scam aimed at people who were already scammed. Your bank and the police don't charge to help.
It asks you to pay a fee before you get something (a prize or a package), or to pay with gift cards, crypto, or a wire transfer. Real companies don't work this way.

cases.why: Recovery scams target people who were already scammed. Nobody legitimate charges up front to get your money back.

cases.summary: Bank: provisional credit while we investigate your fraud claim

input.visibleText: We received your fraud claim. We have issued a provisional credit of $1,200 to your account while we investigate. You don't need to do anything.

cases.why: The bank is giving money back, not asking for any.

cases.summary: Law firm page: recover investment-fraud losses, no upfront fees

input.visibleText: Our attorneys help investors recover losses from investment fraud. Free consultation, and no upfront fees: we are paid only if we recover your money.

cases.why: Says there is no up-front fee.

cases.summary: Article: recovery scams target people who already lost money

input.visibleText: Recovery scams target people who already lost money. Scammers promise to get your money back for a fee. Never pay up front to recover money.
